TestCase.name: testOverWindowInLambdaBody
TestCase.Resource: SELECT ARRAY_TRANSFORM(a, x -> x + SUM(b) OVER (PARTITION BY c)) FROM T

LogicalProject(EXPR$0=[ARRAY_TRANSFORM($0, (x) -> +(x, CASE(>(COUNT($1) OVER (PARTITION BY $2), 0), CAST(SUM($1) OVER (PARTITION BY $2)):INTEGER, null:INTEGER)))]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, T]])

LogicalProject(EXPR$0=[ARRAY_TRANSFORM($0, (x) -> +(x, CASE(>($3, 0), CAST($4):INTEGER, null:INTEGER)))]) +- LogicalProject(a=[$0], b=[$1], c=[$2], $f3=[COUNT($1) OVER (PARTITION BY $2)], $f4=[SUM($1) OVER (PARTITION BY $2)]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, T]])
